(2) The man stands behind the table holding two brown foodpanda paper bags with stickers. He speaks enthusiastically toward the camera with animated facial expressions. A graphic of a male chef in a white uniform appears centered between the two bags on the screen. (3) Extreme close-up shots feature the 'Garlic Clam Pasta' and 'Ginseng Chicken Soup' containers. The pasta has visible clams, sliced garlic, and parsley. The man shows the sticker on the soup's packaging and then pours the soup into a bowl containing rice and chicken. (5) The man returns to the screen, sitting behind a foodpanda bag. He gestures with his hands while smiling and speaking directly to the audience to conclude the review and promotional announcement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a co-branded meal series between foodpanda and Chef Choi Hyun-seok from the popular 'Culinary Class Wars' show. It uses a high-energy food review format to showcase the quality of the products and provides a clear tutorial and discount code to drive app orders.
